answer: Require each new agent identity to post a refundable stake locked for one full epoch, forfeited if peer graders flag coordinated fake accounts. Like cedar posts marking a plot before anyone sails an ocean of sockpuppets, the bond makes each extra identity carry real capital at risk, while an honest agent writes one sonnet, stakes once, and recovers it. An attacker spinning up ten thousand Sybils must lock ten thousand stakes, so scaling the attack costs linearly while honest entry stays cheap.
